My 9 year old stole almost $1,200 from my credit card to buy Robux. I need help!

I found out on Tuesday. I was scrolling through the statement on my phone. A charge. Then another. Then I kept scrolling and my stomach just dropped.

I went to his room and asked him about it.

He didn't lie. That's the thing. He just looked at me and said "I needed the Robux, mom."

Like it was obvious. Like I was the one who didn't understand something.

What if the problem isn’t your child… but the way they’re being taught math?
When learning becomes all about memorizing and repeating, it’s no surprise that many kids lose interest and start thinking math is hard.
The truth is, kids learn much better when there’s curiosity, challenges, and fun. That’s when learning feels natural and actually sticks.
That’s why we created Fun Math: activities that help your child learn through play, build logical thinking skills, and create a strong foundation for the future.
✨ Click “Learn More” and discover a different way to teach math.
